One of Tibia's classic quests, deep in Edron's {wiki:Hero Cave}. Cross the level 100 Gate of Expertise, open the Gate of the Lost Souls with the help of two players and face at least 9 {creature:Demon|Demons} and many {creature:Banshee|Banshees} on the way to the quest room. There you receive the {item:Demon Helmet}, the {item:Demon Shield}, the {item:Steel Boots} and the first addon of the {wiki:Demon Outfits|Demon Outfit}.
Minimum level 100 to pass the Gate of Expertise (120+ recommended).
{item:Key 6010} (golden key), obtained in the {wiki:Parchment Room Quest}, to open the door after the Gate of Expertise.
A team able to take on at least 9 Demons; even if you want to do the quest on your own, you need **2 more players** to stand on the switches of the Gate of the Lost Souls.
golden key from the Parchment Room Quest
for the rope holes on the way to the Demon Hell and to climb back up the Hero Cave
Enough potions and runes for a long fight against Demons and Banshees
Bring a large team with good blockers and shooters: you will face 5 Demons on the way, 4 in the quest room and possibly a respawn on the way back, plus lots of Banshees.
Doing this quest alone is not recommended.

If you are not in Edron, take a boat: talk to the harbour captain in your city (for example {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais) and say {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}. You arrive at the port of **Edron**, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. From the port, head **north** to the entrance of the {wiki:Hero Cave}, north of the city.
Enter the {wiki:Hero Cave} of **Edron** ({coord:33164,31638,7}) and go down until you reach the level 100 Gate of Expertise, near the spawn of a single Demon.
Location of the level 100 Gate of Expertise

On the way there are {creature:Dragon|Dragons}, several {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Wild Warrior|Wild Warriors}, {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Hero|Heroes}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans} and {creature:Monk (Creature)|Monks}.
Open the door with the golden key
Pass the Gate of Expertise and use the {item:Key 6010} (golden key) to open the door right after it.

2. Gate of the Lost Souls and the fire path
Put **two players** on the switches to open the Gate of the Lost Souls (the wall that opens) and go through.
The two switches where two players have to stand
The wall that opens when the two players are on the switches

Kill all the {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals} and follow the passage until you reach a portal (there is only one possible path). On the way: after the wall head **north** and then **east**; you go down a staircase into a pit with about **15 Fire Elementals** (6–7 right at the entrance), go up some stairs, pass a few more Fire Elementals and a few rope holes/ramps (use the {item:Rope}) and reach the teleport.
There is a lot of {item:Fire Field|fire} on the way, but it shouldn't be a problem for level 100+.

Enter the portal: you go down a floor to the lone Demon's room. On the other side there is **one {creature:Demon}**: kill it and go down the hole shown in the picture (the hole to the **east**). Below it there is another hole, so you fall **2 floors** at once.
The teleport in this room takes you back to the first teleport: this is how you will leave at the end.
The hole you should go down after the portal

The hole takes you **2 floors down**, to the cave with the portal to the quest room. Here there are **4 {creature:Demon|Demons}** and a few {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}, but they don't all come at once: there are 2 Demons where you arrive and, heading **east**, one Demon in each room. Head east and kill every creature until you see the portal to the quest room.
Enter the portal: you appear in a room just below, with **4 {creature:Demon|Demons}** and lots of {creature:Banshee|Banshees}.
Quest room: #1 boxes with the rewards (west), #2 exit portal lever (east)
Pull the **lever (#2)** on the **east** side of the room: it activates the exit portal. Do this **before** you kill anything, so that someone can escape if needed.
Without pulling this lever the exit portal doesn't work.
After you kill the creatures, open the boxes with the rewards on the **west** side of the room (#1).
Demon Helmet, Demon Shield, Steel Boots and the Demon Outfit first addon
Leave through the portal (activated by lever #2).
Beware of Demons that may have respawned on the way back.

To get back to the surface: in the main part of the {wiki:Demon Hell}, the stairs up are a little **west** (left) of where you fell. Climb them and climb the next stairs: you arrive in the lone Demon's room again (you can't go back down by those stairs). In that room, enter the teleport, which takes you back to the first teleport. From there redo the route in reverse: ramps and rope holes (with the {item:Rope}), the Fire Elemental pit, the Gate of the Lost Souls wall and the level 100 door, and climb the Hero Cave back to the entrance.
If the Gate of the Lost Souls wall is closed when you come back, arrange with the team for two players to go back to the switches.
Outside, head **south** to the city of **Edron**. To leave the island talk to {npc:Captain Seahorse} at the port ({key:hi}, the name of the city, for example {key:thais}, and {key:yes}).
